nota: Idea elegida por el detector nuevo `outliers` (7-nov): 'How to Fix the National Debt, by Warren Buffett' hizo 500x los subs de su canal (10,3 M vistas, 20.700 subs, like 4,2 %, el mas alto del top 20). Se copia la IDEA, no el clip. Fuentes: CNBC 28-oct-2011 (cita textual de la entrevista del 7-jul-2011 y declaracion de Berkshire), CRFB 1-oct-2026 (deficit FY2026 $2,0 billones = 6,2 % del PIB; intereses $1,1 billones, mas que defensa), CRFB 16-oct-2026 (Treasury confirma $2 billones).

frases.texto: Warren Buffett, the world's most famous investor, said he could end America's deficit in five minutes. You won't guess how.
No tax hike. No spending cut. One law.
Any year the deficit tops three percent of the economy,
every sitting member of Congress is banned from re-election.
Last year's deficit? Two trillion dollars.
That's about double his line. Under his law, nobody in Congress keeps their seat.
The honest part: he said it with a laugh, live on CNBC. His own company called it not a serious proposal.
The point was incentives. People fix what costs them their job.
Remember his five minutes next time you vote.
Warren Buffett, the billionaire investor, had a five-minute fix for the deficit. Congress would hate it, and you might love it.
July twenty eleven. A live TV interview in Idaho.
He said: pass one law. If the deficit tops three percent of the economy,
every sitting member of Congress can't run again.
Fast forward. Last year, America borrowed two trillion dollars.
Interest on the debt now costs more than the military.
The catch: Buffett was joking. His company said it was never a serious plan.
His real point? When nobody pays for failure, failure keeps happening.
Remember those five minutes next time you vote.

ganchos.texto: Warren Buffett, the world's most famous investor, said he could end America's deficit in five minutes. You won't guess how.
Warren Buffett, the billionaire investor, says one law fixes the national debt, and you'd vote for it.
The richest investor of his era gave Congress a five-minute fix. They ignored it, and you pay for it.
Warren Buffett, the investor, wrote a deficit plan that fires all of Congress. You'd sign it.

contradiccion.nota: Una sola ley; el bucle 'you won't guess how' se resuelve a los ~9 s y abre otro: ¿qué pasaría hoy? Se cierra con 'nobody keeps their seat' a ~17 s

misterio.nota: La fecha y el lugar frenan el arranque; el cierre no retoma el gancho

contradiccion+g1.nota: Promesa concreta (5 minutos) + misterio del cómo; habla al espectador

contradiccion+g2.nota: 'says' en presente es falso: lo dijo en 2011; revela 'one law' demasiado pronto

contradiccion+g3.nota: 'richest investor of his era' no verificado; quita el nombre que es el imán

contradiccion+g4.nota: 'wrote a plan' es falso: fue una frase en TV, no un plan escrito
